title: dev-08: Parser — inline component and quantity parsing
description: Implement parsing of @ingredient, #cookware, and ~timer inline components including the brace body / quantity semantics. Split brace body on first %, resolve Value (integer, decimal, fraction, text), resolve unit. Enforce error cases: empty component name, empty value with non-empty unit, multiple % characters. Parser builds Ingredient, Cookware, Timer values and appends them to collector arrays; returns an Item referencing the index.
acceptance_criteria: @name parses to Ingredient with quantity nil.
@name{} parses to Ingredient with quantity nil.
@name{   } parses to Ingredient with quantity nil.
@name{500%g} parses to Ingredient with Quantity(value: .number(500.0), unit: "g").
@name{1/2%cup} parses to Ingredient with Quantity(value: .number(0.5), unit: "cup").
@name{a pinch} parses to Ingredient with Quantity(value: .text("a pinch"), unit: nil).
@name{1,5%g} parses to Ingredient with Quantity(value: .text("1,5"), unit: "g").
@name{500%} parses to Ingredient with Quantity(value: .number(500.0), unit: nil).
'{}'  with no preceding name (empty component name) throws CooklangError.parse.
